name: Ambuscade's +35% Skullpiercer/Flank bonus only applies with a polearm equipped (#2496)
contract: 705053 'Ambuscade' reads 'Increases the base damage of Skullpiercer and Flank by 20%, plus an additional 35% if you have a polearm equipped.' It is a passive with effect 0 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, BasePoints 19+1=20%, class mask word1 0x8020000 = bits 17 and 27) applied unconditionally, and effect 1 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (amplitude 10000 ms) casting 707887 every 10 sec. 707887 carries the identical class mask, ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 0, BasePoints 34+1=35%, DurationIndex 38 (11000 ms), and EquippedItemClass 2/EquippedItemSubClassMask 64 (polearm). 707887 is not passive, so every periodic retrigger runs through Spell::CheckCast/CheckItems (Spell.cpp), which fails SPELL_FAILED_EQUIPPED_ITEM_CLASS without a polearm equipped; the aura's own 11 sec duration outlives the 10 sec retrigger by 1 sec so a continuously-equipped polearm keeps it refreshed. PR #5421 called Ambuscade 'an ungated aura-23 tick' by reading only 705053's own EquippedItemClass (-1, unrestricted) and missing that the triggered spell carries its own gate. Item 1406 'Pearl-encrusted Spear' (item_template: class 2, subclass 6 Polearm, AllowableClass -1, RequiredLevel 20, RequiredSkill 0) is a real, unconditionally usable polearm.
